description: The graph illustrates the performance of various models in terms of Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage as a function of the parameter N, which likely represents the number of samples or a related hyperparameter. The x-axis is labeled "N" and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)" and ranges from 75 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 5. There are five distinct lines, each represented by a different color and marker shape: blue with circle markers, orange with square markers, green with star markers, magenta with triangle markers, and yellow with diamond markers. The blue line starts at approximately 94% AUC, increases to about 98% at N=10, and then decreases to around 94% at N=20. The orange line begins at roughly 87% AUC, rises to about 96% at N=10, and then slightly decreases to around 92% at N=20. The green line starts at approximately 86% AUC, increases to about 94% at N=10, and then slightly decreases to around 92% at N=20. The magenta line starts at about 79% AUC, increases sharply to approximately 96% at N=10, and then decreases to around 82% at N=20. The yellow line starts at about 84% AUC, increases to approximately 95% at N=10, and then slightly decreases to around 94% at N=20. All lines show a general trend of increasing AUC with N up to a peak around N=10, followed by a decline.
